description: Use when designing, configuring, distributing, or troubleshooting Salesforce Surveys and Feedback Management. Triggers: 'create a survey', 'NPS score', 'survey invitation', 'survey response report', 'customer feedback form', 'guest user survey access', 'SurveyInvitation', 'SurveySubject', 'SurveySettings', 'sendSurveyInvitation', 'survey not linked to case', 'deploy a survey between orgs'. NOT for choosing between CSAT, NPS, and CES as your CX metric — use architect/customer-effort-scoring. NOT for third-party survey tools like SurveyMonkey or Qualtrics.
inputs: survey use case and target audience (internal vs external)
Salesforce edition and Feedback Management tier
the business record the responses must be reportable against (Case, Account, Order…)
name: salesforce-surveys
official_sources: Metadata API Developer Guide — `SurveySettings` (`Survey.settings` file location, `enableSurvey` / `enableSurveyOwnerCanManageResponse` / `enableIndustriesCxmEnabled` / `enableGenerativeAISurveys` defaults, API 47.0+, package.xml `Settings`/`Survey` shape) — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/api_meta.pdf (L127607–127690)

Metadata API Developer Guide — `Flow.processType` values `Survey` (API 42.0+) and `SurveyEnrich` (API 49.0+), the Flow deployment limitations (managed-package access, the "Deploy processes and flows as active" production gate, the paused-interview delete rule), the `sendSurveyInvitation` / `dynamicSendSurveyInvitation` / `performSurveySentimentAnalysis` action types, `exportSurveyResponses` reserved for future use, `IframeWhiteListUrlSettings` `context` = `Surveys`, `EmbeddedServiceFlowConfig.flowType` = `LA_Survey`, and the `SurveyQuestionType` enum on `BusinessProcessGroup` — same PDF (L68033–68042, L68322–68329, L68719, L68886–68893, L69583–69586, L118497–118528, L57226–57240, L31284–31338)

Object Reference — the survey object graph and, critically, which objects support `create()`: `Survey`, `SurveyVersion`, `SurveyPage`, `SurveyQuestion`, `SurveyResponse`, `SurveyQuestionResponse`, `SurveyQuestionScore` are read-only, while `SurveyInvitation`, `SurveySubject`, `SurveyEngagementContext` and `SurveyEmailBranding` are writable; plus `Survey.SurveyType` (SURVEY/BASIC/ASSESSMENT), `SurveyVersion.SurveyStatus`, `SurveyInvitation.ParticipantId` create-not-update, the `Paused` interaction with the anonymity flags, and `SurveyQuestionResponse`'s per-datatype answer columns — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/object_reference.pdf (L274218–276200)

Apex Reference Guide — `ConnectApi.Surveys.sendSurveyInvitationEmail` (300-recipient cap, required `SurveyInvitationEmailInput` properties, `[[SURVEY_INVITATION_URL]]` merge token, Lightning-templates-only, `Queued`/`Failed` output), the `sfdc_surveys.SurveyInvitationLinkShortener` interface and its Feedback Management licence requirement, and the shipped "Example Implementation to Associate SurveySubjects with SurveyInvitation and SurveyResponses" that this skill's Apex pattern is built from — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/apexrefguide.pdf (L105274–105330, L118630–118710, L142106–142125, L196143–196310)

REST API Developer Guide — Salesforce Surveys Translation Resources at `/services/data/vXX.X/localizedvalue` (REST 48.0+), and its statement that "The translated values of surveys fields are stored in Flow fields", corroborating that a survey is Flow metadata — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/api_rest.pdf (L7440–7443, L20036–20060)

Salesforce App Limits Cheat Sheet — checked and reported as a **negative result**: `grep -n -i "survey"` returns zero hits, so no Feedback Management response cap is grounded there; the 300 / 100K / unlimited figures in this skill carry an UNVERIFIED marker in `gotchas.md` Gotcha 1 — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/salesforce_app_limits_cheatsheet.pdf

Salesforce Well-Architected — architecture quality framing for the security, user experience, and scalability tradeoffs above — https://architect.salesforce.com/docs/architect/well-architected/guide/overview.html
outputs: survey design guidance with question type selection
guest user permission checklist for external surveys
deployable SurveySettings / package.xml and a SurveyInvitation + SurveySubject automation shape
